eod.conclusion: Indian markets closed higher with both Nifty and Sensex posting significant gains. Financial stocks showed mixed performance while auto and IT sectors drove momentum. Bond markets faced pressure from rising yields, contrasting with the rupee's RBI-supported rally. Corporate earnings season delivered divergent results, with some companies posting strong growth while others struggled with profitability. Cryptocurrencies remained range-bound ahead of key economic decisions.
